exercises.title: THE LAST LEAF
pages: In a little district west of Washington Square two young artists shared a flat: Sue and Johnsy. In November a cold, invisible stranger walked through the town, touching people — the doctor called him pneumonia. Johnsy lay almost still on her bed, and through the window she could see the bare wall of the opposite house and an old ivy vine climbing half-way up.

«Leaves,» she said to Sue. «On the vine. When the last leaf falls, I will go too. I have known this for three days.» The old ivy was losing its leaves one by one in the cold wind. «Oh, I never heard such nonsense,» cried Sue. «Try to eat your soup!» But Johnsy only watched the leaves fall. The old painter Behrman, who lived downstairs and always talked about his future masterpiece, heard everything from Sue. That night the north wind and the rain worked together over the little district.

In the morning Johnsy asked to open the window. And there, on the wall — one ivy leaf, dark green in the grey morning, hanging from a branch. It did not fall in the wind, it did not fall in the rain. All that day and the next night it stayed there. «I have been a bad girl,» whispered Johnsy. «Somebody wants me to live.» The leaf saved her life. Only much later Sue told her: Behrman painted his leaf — his real masterpiece — in the storm, on that terrible night. He caught pneumonia and died two days after. The last leaf stayed on the wall for many days — a true masterpiece.

options: When the last leaf falls, she will die.
exercises.explain: Джонси связывает свою смерть с падением последнего листа: When the last leaf falls, I will go too.

exercises.prompt: Why did the last leaf never fall?
options: Behrman painted it on the wall during the storm.
The wind stopped for a week.
exercises.explain: В финале Сью объясняет: Берман нарисовал лист на стене ночью во время бури.

options: He caught pneumonia and died after painting the leaf.
He sold his masterpiece and became rich.
exercises.explain: После этой ночи Берман заболел пневмонией и умер через два дня.

exercises.prompt: Why is the painted leaf «a true masterpiece»?
options: It cost the artist his life and saved another's.
It was the biggest picture in the city.
It looked exactly like a real leaf.
exercises.explain: Лист вернул Джонси надежду; Берман пожертвовал жизнью. Так в этой адаптации раскрывается смысл слова masterpiece.

exercises.prompt: ФИНАЛЬНЫЙ ТЕСТ: Yesterday she ___ the whole evening reading. (spend)
exercises.explain: yesterday + вечер (закрытый отрезок) → Past Simple: spent.

exercises.prompt: ФИНАЛЬНЫЙ ТЕСТ: If it ___ tomorrow, we will paint indoors.
exercises.explain: После if — Present Simple: If it rains...

exercises.prompt: ФИНАЛЬНЫЙ ТЕСТ: The doctor ___ visit her tonight. (обязан)
exercises.explain: must + V1 без to: The doctor must visit her.
give up = сдаваться. Never give up — никогда не сдавайся.

exercises.prompt: Переведите: Если пойдёт дождь, мы останемся дома.
exercises.answer: If it rains, we will stay home.
exercises.explain: If + rains; will stay в главной части. Допустимо stay at home.
Допустимо didn’t give up. После did not — give, не gave.

objective: Понять мотивы героев и применить изученные конструкции.
